meta_title: Vortex Plumbing and Drains | Plumber Southampton
meta_description: Vortex Plumbing and Drains offer expert plumbing and drain services across Southampton. Fast response, honest pricing, fully qualified. Call for a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Qualified Plumber — Fast Response Across Southampton
hero_subhead: Blocked drain or burst pipe causing chaos? We arrive fast, fix it right, and leave your home exactly as we found it.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Drain Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From emergency drain clearances and burst pipes to boiler upgrades and full bathroom installations, Vortex Plumbing and Drains handles every job with care and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, and plumbing failures dealt with swiftly to minimise damage to your home. We aim to be on site within 60 minutes across Southampton.

services.title: Drain Clearance & Unblocking
services.desc: Blocked sink, toilet, or external drain? We use high-pressure water jetting and specialist equipment to clear blockages quickly and thoroughly.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks can cause costly structural damage if left unchecked. We locate the source accurately and carry out a lasting repair with minimal disruption.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Full supply and fit of bathrooms, en-suites, and wet rooms, with meticulous attention to tiling, pipework, and finish. Transforming your space from start to finish.

services.title: Boiler & Central Heating
services.desc: Boiler servicing, fault diagnosis, and full central heating installations to keep your home warm and efficient all year round. All work fully compliant with current regulations.

services.title: CCTV Drain Surveys
services.desc: Our CCTV drain surveys identify blockages, root intrusion, collapsed sections, and structural defects before they become expensive problems. Detailed reports provided.

about_pullquote: Every job we do has to be something we're genuinely proud of.
about_para_1: Vortex Plumbing and Drains was founded with a straightforward goal: to give Southampton homeowners a reliable, honest plumbing service they can actually count on. With over a decade of hands-on experience across residential and commercial properties, our team is fully qualified and committed to doing the job properly, first time.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation across Southampton on word-of-mouth recommendations and repeat custom — and we intend to keep it that way. No hidden charges, no unnecessary upselling, and no job too small. When you call Vortex, you get a tradesperson who turns up on time, communicates clearly, and takes real pride in their work.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Vortex

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service. Had a badly blocked drain on a Sunday evening and Vortex were with us within the hour. Job sorted cleanly and quickly, and the price was very fair. Will definitely be using them again.
reviews.author: Claire B.

reviews.text: Used Vortex to fit a new bathroom and I couldn't be happier with the result. Tidy workers, kept us informed throughout, and the finish is excellent. Really trustworthy company — highly recommend.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Called them out for a leak under the kitchen sink that two other plumbers had failed to fix properly. They found the actual cause straight away and repaired it neatly. Refreshing to deal with someone who actually knows what they're doing.
reviews.author: Sandra W.
